## About
Steve Wiley has been well-known in the hot rod and racing industry for a long time. He put together a team and formed Wiley's Speed Shop, a family owned and operated shop on 2nd St in Joshua, Texas.
We work on classic cars and hot rods, from restorations and upholstery to race car fabrication. Before we start any upgrades, we take the time to learn what you want from your car. Our philosophy is simple: do it right.
You'll know from the parking lot that our standards are high. Cleanliness, safety and respect for you and your vehicle show in everything we do. Customers give us 4.7 stars from 26 Google reviews.

## Services
- Restoration and service of vintage cars and trucks: Restoration and ongoing service for vintage cars and trucks.
- Paint & body restoration work and repair: Custom paint and body work. We restore sheet metal to factory specifications, locating replacement panels or fabricating them in house.
- Mechanical Repairs: Drivetrain restoration and upgrades, with any job big or small, from routine maintenance to a complete restoration.
- Creature comfort and performance upgrades: Modern comfort and more performance for your classic.
- Custom fabrication: Custom body work, frame fabrication, mounts and brackets built in our fab shop.
- Rust repair, floor pan replacement and engine swap modifications: The metal and fitment work that keeps an old car solid and ready for a new engine.
- Upholstery: Interior work for classic cars and hot rods.
- Race car specialty fabrication and repair: Fabrication and repair for race cars, from a shop with roots in hot rods and racing.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with insurance companies?
A: Yes. We work with insurance companies to get your classic back on the road.

Q: What if the parts for my car can't be found?
A: We don't let missing parts stop the work. If a part can't be found, we build it in our fab shop.

Q: Will you take on a project someone else started?
A: Yes. Untouched originals or projects you started but never finished, we enjoy the challenge.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We're open weekdays and closed Saturday and Sunday. Come by during the week and we'd love to show you around.
